# Gdrive_X State — 2026-05-02

Scope: exhaustive read-only reconnaissance of `$HOME/Gdrive_X/` before any reorganization action.

Status: no move, rename, delete, or creation happened inside `$HOME/Gdrive_X/`.

## Method

- Traversed the full mounted tree with folder-first scans and recursive inventory extraction.
- Measured sizes, file counts, directory counts, extension distribution, hidden/system residues, and name anomalies.
- Compared mirrored branches to identify dominant structures and semantic collisions before proposing any target model.

## Major Findings

- `Media/` is the largest root by far and is mostly outside the intended academic/professional mission of `Gdrive_X`.
- `Academic/X/` is the real academic center, but it contains duplicate personal-X subtrees (`Academic/X/K𝜋X/`) and mixed naming conventions.
- `Identity/Professional/` contains professional material, but also runtime/repository metadata that should not live in a clean document drive.
- `Labs/` mixes active project work, reference knowledge, and infrastructure backups under one semantic roof.
- `Homelab/` duplicates the intent already present in `Labs/Homelab/Backups/`.
- `Google AI Studio/`, `Old/`, `tmp/`, and `.Trash-1000/` prove the root still acts partly as a dump/sync surface instead of a curated system.

## Collision and Duplication Signals

| Branch A | Branch B | Entries A | Entries B | Overlap |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `Academic/X/Dossier_Integration` | `Academic/X/K𝜋X/Dossier_Intégration` | 42 | 58 | 5 |
| `Academic/X/Bourses/Bourse_Eiffel` | `Academic/X/K𝜋X/Bourse_Eiffel` | 4 | 18 | 0 |
| `Media/Photos/Persos/X` | `Media/Photos/OneDrive_Sync/X` | 1420 | 2121 | 1201 |
| `Media/Photos/Persos/Importants` | `Media/Photos/OneDrive_Sync/Importants` | 139 | 149 | 127 |

Interpretation:

- `Media/Photos/Persos/X` and `Media/Photos/OneDrive_Sync/X` are massive mirrored trees and must be merged before any final placement.
- `Media/Photos/Persos/Importants` and `Media/Photos/OneDrive_Sync/Importants` are also strongly overlapped and need semantic splitting, not blind coexistence.
- `Academic/X/Dossier_Integration` and `Academic/X/K𝜋X/Dossier_Intégration` are clearly related and should become one canonical admissions/integration branch.
